UP CEBU STAGES ISKOLARO AND COOKOUT 2026

The University of the Philippines Cebu held its annual Iskolaro and Cookout from March 23 to 27, 2026, with this year's edition extending beyond sports and celebration amid ongoing concerns over budget cuts, displacement, and economic pressure on Filipino communities.

Carrying the theme "DAGAN: Dula sa Kalisdanan, Panaghiusa sa Kadaugan," the week-long program drew participation from across colleges through sporting competitions, cultural performances, and community engagements. Vendors from Carbon Public Market joined the program, a lightning rally drew over 200 participants, and cheerdance routines highlighted the struggles of farmers, workers, and indigenous peoples. The week concluded with a live performance of DAGAN 2026's official theme song, capping five days of competition, advocacy, and collective expression.

📷: Tug-ani
